profile.headline: Web Developer
profile.summary:
I am a junior web developer working at Educational Service District 112 who is experienced with JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, Bootstrap, SQL, HTML, CSS, and Git. 

In my currrent role, I work on both the frontend and backend to design and develop new features, perform maintenance work, and provide support on a monolithic web application that utilizes various micro-service applications deployed on Microsoft Azure. I leverage a Microsoft oriented web development tech stack of React, TypeScript, and Bootstrap for the frontend and ASP.NET, C#, Enitity Framework, SQL Server/Azure SQL, and Node.js for the backend.

My past work experience involves launching SF State's redesigned and overhauled Bursar’s Office department website that went live over the Spring 2022 semester for students, faculty, and staff to use, integrating the new Engineering Success Center into the SF State School of Engineering website, and working a summer internship at a startup focused on creating a social network to connect like-minded entrepreneurs.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
• Assists with the development, design, testing, and support of the PCI-DSS compliant pdEnroller web app which tracks certified clock hours for over 280,000 Washington teachers
• Utilizes JavaScript/TypeScript, React, HTML, CSS, and libraries such as React-Bootstrap, and Kendo-UI to create frontend UI components
• Creates API endpoints, controllers, data models, and services using C#, ASP.Net Core/MVC, Entity Framework, SQL Server, Vite, Node.js, and GraphQL
• Monitors pdEnroller hosted on Microsoft Azure for OWASP vulnerabilities, performance, and logs through Azure SQL
• Led the process of integrating Skyward Qmaltiv into pdEnroller web app to enable custom features such as remote revenue/expense ledger account search within Qmlativ to apply towards clock hour event pricing
• Developed account self merge feature to allow users to merge verified multiple accounts on their own, reducing duplicate account support tickets by 80%

• Collaborated weekly with cross-functional team of 7, using Kanban and Trello to prioritize deliverables

positions.title: Web Designer (Bursar's Office)
positions.description:
• Overhauled old website infrastructure with Drupal 8 CMS, resulting in 42 organized, maintainable pages
• Resolved 213 accessibility barriers via HTML, allowing assistive technology users to access web content
• Redesigned UI with Pattern Lab components to improve UX, shortening average task time to 2 minutes
• Collaborated weekly with cross-functional team of 6, launching website to production 1 month early
positions.insights: Collaborative Problem Solving, HTML5 and +3 skills

projects.title: Alert Blurt
projects.description:
A web app created for the Chirp Developer Challenge that aims to keep people safe and informed by alerting them of dangerous real world events such as natural disasters, mass shootings, amber alerts, and public health notices.

Features:
• Select alert types that fetches relevant tweets through Twitter’s API v2 to keep users informed and updated
• Feed is updated in real time based on new Twitter updates mentioning the alert type

Tech Stack:
• Frontend: React, TypeScript, Material UI, Axios
• Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Redis, AWS Elastic Compute Cloud, PM2, Linux (Ubuntu)

projects.title: Gator XChange
projects.description:
React, Bootstrap, Node.js, Express.js, MySQL, AWS EC2, Nginx, PM2, Axios, Git, Bcrypt, Google Analytics
• Conceptualized and developed a C2C web app tailored for SFSU members on a scrum team of 6 students
• Led agile software development life cycle as backend lead, using Kanban and Trello to complete 5 sprints
• Deployed app to AWS EC2 Linux production environment using PM2 and Nginx as HTTP reverse proxy
• Created REST API endpoints using Express.js and Postman and database architecture with MySQL
• Implemented product search’s frontend using React, Bootstrap and backend logic with SQL and Node.js
